medusa_concurrent_hosts.description: Total number of hosts to be tested concurrently.

medusa_concurrent_logins.description: Total number of logins to be tested concurrently.

medusa_connect_timeout.description: Give up after trying to connect for NUM seconds (-g).

medusa_extra_checks.description: Additional password checks: 'n' for No Password, 's' for Password=Username. Leave empty if not used.

medusa_log_file.description: File to append log information to (-O).

medusa_module.description: Name of the module to execute (without .mod extension).

medusa_module_params.description: Custom parameters to pass to the module using -m flags. Can be passed multiple times.

medusa_parallelize_logins.description: Parallelize logins using one username per thread (-L).

medusa_port.description: Use for non-default TCP port number (-n). 0 means use default.

medusa_resume_map.description: Allows basic resuming of a previous scan (-Z). Empty if not resuming.

medusa_retries.description: Attempt NUM retries before giving up (-R). Total attempts = NUM + 1.

medusa_retry_sleep.description: Sleep NUM seconds between retry attempts (-r).

medusa_socket_check_usec.description: Set the number of usec waited during socket test (-c).

medusa_stop_audit_on_first_match.description: Stop audit after first valid username/password found on any host (-F).

medusa_stop_on_first_match.description: Stop scanning host after first valid username/password found (-f).

medusa_target_host.description: Target hostname or IP address to audit.
